scope: Read-only authentication, weekly GPU quota, ARC2 submission limits, and latest Notebook statuses for the three user-prioritized accounts. No GPU start, notebook push, code submission, account-default change, or credential-file modification.

authentication.method: Each account is queried in its own subprocess. KAGGLE_API_TOKEN is set only in that subprocess environment to the existing credential file path. Installed kagglesdk get_access_token_from_env reads that file internally.
authentication.note: KAGGLE_API_TOKEN accepts an existing path in this installed SDK. Do not interpolate the credential contents into shell command text. Verify authenticated username before every mutation.

quota_semantics.multiplier_note: Planning buffer, not observed billing. No six-hour reserve is imposed on each old account.
quota_semantics.live_balance_note: The balances are a snapshot shared with other projects on each account. Recheck immediately before launch.
